node.title: L1 background-quotient Johnson bound
node.statement: For one source chart, defect degree, and exact h-point petal support X, put N=k-1, c=N-h, s=h-d, b=ell-g, and u=ell-s. Subtracting the degree-<h interpolant on X and dividing by L_X injects compatible codewords into degree-at-most-c polynomials on the b-point background that agree with one derived word in at least u positions. If u^2>bc, the Johnson bound gives at most b(u-c)/(u^2-bc)<=n^2 codewords, so all such cells are polynomial per chart at fixed petal polarity. The live balanced tail also satisfies (ell-a+c)^2<=(ell-g)c together with a^2/N<=c<=2a-ell-g. The exact F_17 equality cell (b,u,c)=(1,1,1) has two contributors, so strictness is load-bearing.
